## Guidance

Exactly copy target signatures from literal 05 into real namespaces, PHPStan generics and direct symbol imports. Validate options eagerly, preserve named arguments. DTO unions не доверяют model attrs. UploadSource::fromStream размер>=0, resource readable; fromPath non-existent open throws deterministic exception, never raw entire path in public error. Reader factories never read whole source early. FileStream caller owns returned stream after successful read; request adapter finally closes. Test constructor/fluent snapshots and namespaces via reflection, not snapshot only. Core public API has zero drive/media/documents imports. Required signatures blueprint activation in P3.3 is executable map, no deferred design questions.
